set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the Teleport principal to prevent further break-glass use pending investigation
tctl lock --user=carol.tan@eproc.test --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0009: Unauthorized SUPERUSER grant to analyst_ro outside approved change window. Locked pending investigation."

# 2. Capture forensic snapshot of analyst_ro role attributes and ensure NOSUPERUSER
psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 <<'EOSQL'
-- Forensic quarantine table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0009 (
    captured_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
    rolname      name,
    rolsuper     boolean,
    rolcreaterole boolean,
    rolcreatedb  boolean,
    rolcanlogin  boolean
);

-- Snapshot current state before any corrective action
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0009
       (rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin)
SELECT  rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin
FROM    pg_roles
WHERE   rolname = 'analyst_ro';

-- Idempotently ensure analyst_ro does not retain superuser
ALTER ROLE analyst_ro NOSUPERUSER;
EOSQL
